article.headline: Deadly Nor'Easter Batters Northeast Coast With Storm Surge and Coastal Flooding
article.summary: A powerful nor'easter is unleashing severe coastal flooding, beach erosion, and damaging winds across the Northeast, with storm surge already destroying seawalls in Massachusetts communities.
article.body:
A dangerous nor'easter is pummeling the Northeast with unprecedented fury, bringing deadly conditions and catastrophic coastal damage to the region. According to FOX Weather, the storm is generating severe coastal flooding, beach erosion, and damaging winds that pose immediate threats to life and property across multiple states.

Massachusetts' South Shore has emerged as a particular flashpoint, with WCVB reporting that coastal communities in the region experienced significant impacts over the weekend. Scituate, a vulnerable coastal town, suffered direct damage to its seawalls as powerful waves and strong winds battered the shoreline. The storm surge—the abnormal rise in water level during the nor'easter—has proven especially destructive to coastal infrastructure designed to protect homes and businesses.

FOX Weather is actively tracking live updates as the nor'easter continues its assault on the Northeast. The network is monitoring real-time radar data, compiling power outage reports, and issuing updated weather forecasts as conditions evolve. Dangerous winds are whipping through the region, compounding hazards from the rising water and erosion.

The combination of storm surge, coastal flooding, and high winds creates a perfect storm scenario for coastal communities. Residents in affected areas face threats ranging from property damage and beach erosion to power outages and dangerous travel conditions. Emergency management officials are urging coastal residents to remain vigilant and follow evacuation orders as the nor'easter continues its destructive passage.

article.headline: Son Heung-min Chases All-Time Record as South Korea Faces Uruguay Tonight

South Korea's national football team will clash with Uruguay tonight at Seoul World Cup Stadium at 8 p.m. in a high-stakes friendly match, according to Chosunbiz. Head coach Robert Moreno has named captain Son Heung-min in the starting XI alongside Lee Kang-in in a two-striker formation, with Oh in the lineup as well.

Lee Kang-in, speaking at an official press conference held at the stadium a day before kickoff, expressed confidence in the squad's cohesion. "All players worked hard for the team," Lee told reporters via SBS News. "I have high expectations as I am playing a match in Korea after a long time."

This friendly serves as a crucial test for Moreno's tactical approach following his managerial debut against Ecuador. The two-striker system featuring Son and Lee Kang-in represents an aggressive attacking strategy designed to penetrate Uruguay's defense. With Son hunting the historic goal milestone and Lee Kang-in energized by playing domestically, South Korea aims to deliver a commanding performance in front of their home crowd.

article.headline: Atlantic City's Iconic Sheraton Hotel Faces December Closure Without State Rescue
article.summary: The Sheraton Atlantic City Convention Center Hotel risks permanent closure this December unless state officials intervene with emergency funding or subsidies to save the struggling property.
article.body:
Atlantic City's convention infrastructure faces an existential crisis as the Sheraton hotel owner warns that traditional business models can no longer sustain the property. According to WHYY, the developer spearheading a proposed $100 million overhaul states that partial residential conversion represents the only viable path forward without direct state financial backing.

The stakes have intensified as officials sound alarms about competing threats. CDC Gaming reported that an Atlantic City official told Governor Phil Murphy that a new convention center in the Meadowlands would trigger devastating consequences for the city's existing convention economy, potentially forcing both the Atlantic City Convention Center and its adjacent Sheraton hotel into closure.

The Sheraton's December deadline has triggered urgent action. According to Focus Gaming News, a Casino Reinvestment Development Authority board member is actively seeking a comprehensive state rescue plan to explore all available options for keeping the property operational. The hotel, which anchors Atlantic City's convention business, has become a flashpoint in debates over the city's economic future.

Without intervention, industry insiders warn the closures would cripple Atlantic City's ability to attract large conventions and conferences—a revenue stream crucial to the city's casino economy and employment base. State officials now face mounting pressure to either fund the Sheraton's transformation or block competing projects like the proposed Meadowlands convention center that could accelerate the hotel's decline. The outcome will determine whether Atlantic City can maintain its relevance as a convention destination or surrender that market entirely.

article.headline: Son Heung-min Chases Legendary Goal Record Against Uruguay in Seoul Showdown
article.summary: South Korea's star striker Son Heung-min will attempt to break Cha Bum-kun's all-time goal record in a high-stakes friendly against Uruguay on September 28, with attacking partner Lee Kang-in also starting.
article.body: South Korea's national football team faces its toughest test under new Spanish manager Robert Moreno on September 28 at Seoul World Cup Stadium, taking on South American powerhouse Uruguay in a friendly match. The centerpiece of the clash is Son Heung-min's pursuit of Cha Bum-kun's all-time goal record. Son will chase his 58th international goal, seeking to surpass Cha's historic tally, according to Chosun Ilbo. Manager Moreno, appointed after South Korea's disappointing exit from the 2026 North-Central American World Cup group stage in July, is mounting his first real examination against elite opposition. Having demolished Ecuador in his debut match, Moreno now faces a genuine acid test. Lee Kang-in of Atlético Madrid will partner Son Heung-min of LAFC in a potent attacking duo, according to Korea Daily. The match marks the second of four September-October A-Match fixtures for South Korea. Moreno commands a temporary squad through November, overseeing six total A-Matches as interim leadership. South Korea enters the contest as underdogs historically against Uruguay, the two-time World Cup champion and CONMEBOL stalwart. However, the combination of Son's record-chasing ambitions and Moreno's tactical vision offers genuine hope for victory. Central Ilbo reports this fixture serves as the true measuring stick for Moreno's emerging project after his strong opening performance.

article.headline: Vets Reveal Critical Temperature Threshold When Dogs Face Real Danger Outdoors
article.summary: Veterinarians are warning pet owners that the dangerous cold threshold for dogs is far lower than most assume, challenging the common misconception that fur alone provides adequate winter protection.
article.body:
Pet owners routinely underestimate winter dangers for their dogs, according to veterinary experts cited by Grazia Magazine. Many assume that because dogs have fur, they can safely endure extended outdoor time in freezing temperatures—a belief that ignores the serious health risks lurking below a specific thermal threshold.

Veterinarians stress that the reality is far more nuanced than casual observation suggests. While a quick glance at a thermometer reading in the low thirties Fahrenheit might seem manageable for a furry companion, medical professionals warn that genuine danger emerges at temperatures significantly lower than what most dog owners consider safe.

The misconception stems from a fundamental misunderstanding of canine physiology. Fur provides insulation, but it is not a complete barrier against extreme cold exposure. Factors including breed, age, health status, and coat density all influence how individual dogs tolerate frigid conditions. Small breeds, senior dogs, and those with thin coats face heightened vulnerability to hypothermia and frostbite.

Grazia Magazine's reporting emphasizes that veterinarians recommend severely limiting outdoor exposure below a specific critical temperature, with some dogs barely venturing outside at all under such conditions. Pet owners are advised to consult their veterinarians about safe temperature thresholds for their individual animals and to watch for signs of cold stress, including shivering, reluctance to move, and seeking shelter.

Understanding these scientific guidelines helps owners protect their pets during winter months while avoiding dangerous assumptions based solely on breed characteristics.

article.headline: Tesla Stock Faces Headwinds as Chinese Competition and Delivery Forecasts Shift
article.summary: Tesla's share price confronts renewed pressure from potential Chinese automaker U.S. market entry and sharply reduced delivery guidance, while investor attention splinters toward SpaceX ventures.
article.body:
Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) is navigating a turbulent period marked by multiple structural headwinds that challenge its market dominance. According to Seeking Alpha, the electric vehicle maker confronts mounting competitive threats, particularly the potential U.S. market entry by Chinese automakers—a development that could fragment Tesla's domestic market share and compress margins across the sector.

Delivery forecasts have deteriorated significantly, with analysts revising expectations downward. This pullback in growth projections coincides with broader market reassessment of Tesla's valuation premium, which historically relied on aggressive expansion narratives.

Additionally, investor sentiment has fragmented. Yahoo Finance UK reports that market discourse has shifted materially away from Tesla toward SpaceX, Elon Musk's aerospace venture, which has captured substantial investor enthusiasm and media oxygen. This reallocation of attention—despite Tesla's foundational role in Musk's portfolio—signals potential sentiment decay around the electric vehicle company's growth trajectory.

The convergence of external competitive pressure, internal forecast revisions, and shifting investor psychology creates a confluence of headwinds. Wall Street remains divided on the stock's merit, with some analysts defending long positions while others highlight valuation concerns relative to near-term growth catalysts. The next earnings cycle will prove pivotal in clarifying whether Tesla can stabilize delivery momentum and defend its market leadership against emerging international rivals entering the U.S. EV market.

article.headline: Alaska's Fattest Bears Battle For Crowning Glory In Annual Online Voting Showdown
article.summary: Katmai National Park's beloved Fat Bear Week competition has launched, inviting voters worldwide to crown the heaviest brown bear preparing for winter hibernation.
article.body:
Fat Bear Week, the annual celebration of Alaska's most robust brown bears, has returned with online voting now open through September 29, according to BBC reporting. The iconic contest, run by Katmai National Park and Preserve, showcases the park's bears at their peak weight as they gorge on salmon ahead of winter hibernation.

The competition draws global attention each year as wildlife enthusiasts cast votes for their favorite contenders. Euronews reports that this year's voting period runs from September 22-29, with participants competing to determine which bear has accumulated the most impressive weight gain during the pre-hibernation feeding frenzy.

Katmai's brown bears consume enormous quantities of salmon during the spawning season, with dominant bears catching dozens of fish daily. This hyperphagia phase—when bears eat voraciously to build fat reserves—represents a critical survival mechanism for surviving months without food during winter sleep.

The park's bears depend on abundant salmon runs to successfully prepare for hibernation. According to BBC, the Fat Bear Week voting has become a beloved tradition that educates the public about bear ecology while providing entertaining real-world competition data. Each year, park rangers document and photograph the bears, creating a compelling visual record of their transformations.

The event celebrates these magnificent creatures during their most visually impressive season, combining wildlife education with interactive engagement. Fat Bear Week demonstrates how citizen participation can support conservation awareness and appreciation for Alaska's iconic fauna during one of nature's most dramatic seasonal transformations.

news.og_title: عام / تنفيذ حكم القتل قصاصًا بأحد الجناة في منطقة مكة المكرمة
news.og_desc:
الطائف 16 ربيع الآخر 1448 هـ الموافق 27 سبتمبر 2026 م واس
    أصدرت وزارة الداخلية اليوم، بيانًا بشأن تنفيذ حُكم القتل قصاصًا بأحد الجناة في منطقة مكة المكرمة، فيما يلي نصه:
    قال الله تعالى: (يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آَمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِصَاصُ فِي الْقَتْلَى).
    وقال تعالى: (وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصَاصِ حَيَاةٌ يَاْ أُولِيْ الأَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ).
    أقدم/ صالح بن يحي بن غريبان الصفياني -سعودي الجنسية- على قتل بدر بن فهد بن فهيد المقاطي -سعودي الجنسية- وذلك بإطلاق النار عليه مما أدى إلى وفاته بسبب خلاف بينهما.
    وبفضل من الله تمكّنت الجهات الأمنية من القبض على الجاني المذكور، وأسفر التحقيق معه عن توجيه الاتهام إليه بارتكاب الجريمة، وبإحالته إلى المحكمة المختصة؛ صدر بحقه حكم يقضي بثبوت ما نُسب إليه وقتله قصاصًا، وأصبح الحكم نهائيًا بعد استئنافه ثم تأييده من المحكمة العليا، وصدر أمر ملكي بإنفاذ ما تقرر شرعًا.
    وتم تنفيذ حكم القتل قصاصًا بالجاني/ صالح بن يحي بن غريبان الصفياني -سعودي الجنسية- يوم الأحد 1448/4/16هـ الموافق 2026/9/27م بمنطقة مكة المكرمة.
    ووزارة الداخلية إذ تعلن ذلك لتؤكد للجميع حرص حكومة المملكة العربية السعودية على استتباب الأمن وتحقيق العدل وتنفيذ أحكام الشريعة الإسلامية في كل من يتعدى على الآمنين ويسفك دماءهم وينتهك حقهم في الحياة، وتحذر في الوقت نفسه كل من تسوّل له نفسه الإقدام على مثل ذلك بأن العقاب الشرعي سيكون مصيره.
    والله الهادي إلى سواء السبيل.

article.headline: بن هيونج مين يطارد الرقم القياسي.. كوريا تستقبل أوروجواي ودية قوية الليلة
article.summary: منتخب كوريا الجنوبية يواجه أوروجواي الليلة في مباراة ودية على ملعب سول العالمي، بقيادة المدير الفني روبير مورينو، وسون هيونج مين يسعى لكسر الرقم القياسي التاريخي للمنتخب.
article.body: يستعد منتخب كوريا الجنوبية لمواجهة أوروجواي مساء الليلة بمباراة ودية على ملعب سول العالمي. حسب ما أعلنه المدير الفني روبير مورينو، ستكون هذه المباراة الثانية له مع الفريق بعد مباراة الافتتاح أمام الإكوادور. يقود الفريق الكابتن سون هيونج مين، لاعب فريق لوس أنجلوس سيتي الأمريكي، الذي يسعى من خلال هذه المواجهة لتحقيق إنجاز تاريخي. سون واحدة فقط من الأهداف بعيداً عن تعادل الرقم القياسي لأفضل هدافي منتخب كوريا الجنوبية في المباريات الرسمية. سيكون اللاعب لي كانج إين أيضاً في تشكيل البداية. أعرب لي كانج إين، الذي حضر مباراة ديبوتة مورينو ضد الإكوادور من على المقاعد، عن تفاؤله قبل المواجهة. قال لي خلال المؤتمر الصحفي الرسمي بملعب سول: "لدي توقعات عالية بلعب مباراة في كوريا بعد فترة طويلة". وأضاف أن "جميع اللاعبين عملوا بجد من أجل الفريق" في الديبوتة السابقة. تجسد هذه المباراة اختباراً حقيقياً لمنتخب كوريا الجنوبية ضد قوة جنوب أمريكية معروفة، وفرصة ذهبية لسون هيونج مين لكتابة صفحة جديدة في السجلات التاريخية للمنتخب الكوري.
